purpose: Verify a Student can create a personal placement profile.
preconditions: An authenticated Student has no placement profile.
action_or_input: Create and save a personal placement profile.
expected_result: PCMS saves a new placement profile for that Student.

purpose: Verify a Student can maintain their personal placement profile.
preconditions: An authenticated Student has an existing placement profile.
action_or_input: Edit and save permitted fields in the Student's own profile.
expected_result: PCMS saves the profile updates.

purpose: Verify the profile stores the specified data categories.
preconditions: An authenticated Student can create or update their placement profile.
action_or_input: Save academic records, skills, achievements, certifications, and supported placement-profile documents in the profile.
expected_result: PCMS persists each listed data category and makes it available to supported downstream functions.

purpose: Verify the configured profile-completeness condition gates application submission.
preconditions: Profile completeness is configured as required for application.
action_or_input: Attempt application submission once with a profile that fails the configured completeness condition and once with a profile that satisfies it; in the latter case, use a Student who meets the posting eligibility criteria.
expected_result: PCMS prevents submission when the completeness condition fails and permits submission when it passes.

purpose: Verify PCMS generates a structured resume from saved profile data.
preconditions: A Student has saved placement-profile data.
action_or_input: Request a structured resume.
expected_result: PCMS generates a structured resume using the Student's saved profile data.

purpose: Verify Students can browse opportunities made available through PCMS.
preconditions: A Student is authenticated.
Job and internship opportunities have been published or otherwise made available to the Student through PCMS.
action_or_input: Open the Student opportunity view.
expected_result: The view exposes the job and internship opportunities available to the Student.

purpose: Verify an eligible Student can apply for a job posting.
preconditions: A Student is eligible for a job posting.
Any applicable profile-completeness condition is satisfied.
action_or_input: Submit an application to the job posting.
expected_result: PCMS records the application as Applied.

purpose: Verify PCMS evaluates recorded posting eligibility criteria before accepting an application.
preconditions: A job posting has recorded eligibility criteria.
One Student meets those criteria and another does not.
Any applicable profile-completeness condition is satisfied for both.
action_or_input: Have each Student attempt to apply to the posting.
expected_result: PCMS permits the qualifying Student's application and prevents the non-qualifying Student's application.

purpose: Verify PCMS maintains application history.
preconditions: A Student has submitted an application to an eligible job posting.
action_or_input: Review the application history, including after supported application-state changes.
expected_result: PCMS maintains the recorded application history for the Student's application.

purpose: Verify Students can track supported placement states and related status information.
preconditions: The Student has placement records representing the supported states Applied, Shortlisted, Interview Scheduled, Offer Extended, Offer Accepted, and Offer Rejected, with relevant interview, offer, and final-placement status information recorded.
action_or_input: View the Student's placement records and status information.
expected_result: PCMS exposes the supported states and relevant recorded interview, offer, and final-placement status information to the Student.

purpose: Verify a Student can accept a recorded offer while the applicable response deadline permits it.
preconditions: A Student has a recorded Offer Extended job offer with an applicable response deadline.
action_or_input: Attempt to accept the offer while the deadline permits a response, then attempt acceptance after the represented deadline.
expected_result: PCMS permits acceptance while the deadline allows a response and does not permit acceptance after the represented deadline.

purpose: Verify a Student can reject a recorded offer while the applicable response deadline permits it.
preconditions: A Student has a recorded Offer Extended job offer with an applicable response deadline.
action_or_input: Attempt to reject the offer while the deadline permits a response.
expected_result: PCMS permits the response and records the offer as Offer Rejected.

purpose: Verify accepting an offer updates the Student's placement record.
preconditions: A Student has a recorded job offer that can be accepted within the applicable deadline.
action_or_input: Accept the job offer.
expected_result: PCMS updates the Student's placement record to reflect the accepted placement outcome.

purpose: Verify multiple-offer handling respects only policy logic explicitly represented in PCMS.
preconditions: A Student has multiple recorded offers; exercise the scenario both without an explicitly represented institutional policy rule and, where such a rule exists, with that rule configured.
action_or_input: Attempt the relevant offer actions under each represented policy condition.
expected_result: PCMS does not enforce an unsupported multiple-offer restriction; when an explicit policy rule is represented, PCMS applies that rule.

purpose: Verify Students can view available anonymized placement statistics.
preconditions: Placement statistics have been made available to the Student role.
action_or_input: View placement statistics as a Student.
expected_result: PCMS displays the available anonymized statistics without exposing unauthorized identifiable or sensitive placement data.

purpose: Verify Students can view historical placement data made available to their role.
preconditions: Historical placement data has been made available to the Student role.
action_or_input: View historical placement data as a Student.
expected_result: PCMS exposes the historical placement data made available to the Student role.

purpose: Verify the TPO can create and manage job postings.
preconditions: An authorized TPO is authenticated.
The TPO is acting on behalf of or in coordination with a Company/Recruiter.
action_or_input: Create, upload, update, and manage a job posting through the supported posting function.
expected_result: PCMS allows the TPO to manage the posting and reach a supported publish outcome.

purpose: Verify the supported Company/Recruiter job-opportunity posting paths.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized for the relevant posting activity.
action_or_input: Exercise direct publication of a job opportunity and submission of a job opportunity through the supported TPO-managed publication path.
expected_result: PCMS supports direct publication where authorized and supports submission through the TPO-managed path.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can publish or submit an internship opportunity.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized for the relevant posting activity.
action_or_input: Create an internship opportunity and publish it directly or submit it through a supported PCMS posting path.
expected_result: PCMS supports the authorized internship opportunity publication or submission.

purpose: Verify permitted posting actors can record eligibility criteria within their posting scopes.
preconditions: An authorized TPO and an authorized Company/Recruiter can manage representative opportunities within their respective scopes.
action_or_input: Record eligibility criteria for an opportunity through each authorized actor path.
expected_result: PCMS records eligibility criteria for opportunities each actor is authorized to manage.

purpose: Verify job postings require a role description, eligibility criteria, and application deadline.
preconditions: An authorized actor can create a job posting.
action_or_input: Attempt to save or publish a posting with the role description missing, with the eligibility criteria missing, and with the application deadline missing; then submit a posting containing all three.
expected_result: PCMS validates each posting missing a required item and permits a posting containing all three required items.

purpose: Verify the supported eligibility criteria vocabulary can be represented.
preconditions: An authorized actor can record criteria for an opportunity.
action_or_input: Record criteria using CGPA, branch, year, skills, and other explicitly configured criteria.
expected_result: PCMS can represent the stated criteria without requiring criteria that are not specified as mandatory.

purpose: Verify the TPO can view and review applications within the TPO's authorized scope.
preconditions: An authorized TPO has a defined placement scope.
Applications exist both within and outside that scope.
action_or_input: Open and review applications as the TPO.
expected_result: PCMS allows access to applications within the TPO's scope and prevents access to applications outside that scope.

purpose: Verify the TPO can filter applications within the TPO's authorized scope.
preconditions: An authorized TPO has access to multiple applications within the TPO's placement scope.
action_or_input: Apply a supported filter to the application set.
expected_result: PCMS displays the relevant filtered application set without changing application state.

purpose: Verify the TPO can administratively manage applications without taking unsupported Company selection decisions.
preconditions: An authorized TPO has applications within the TPO's placement scope.
action_or_input: Use supported TPO administrative application-management actions and inspect whether those actions assign Company selection outcomes.
expected_result: PCMS supports TPO administrative management within scope and does not assign unsupported Company selection authority to the TPO.

purpose: Verify the TPO can schedule interviews in coordination with Companies/Recruiters.
preconditions: An authorized TPO is coordinating with a Company/Recruiter.
A candidate has a supported shortlisted state.
action_or_input: Record a valid interview schedule for the candidate.
expected_result: PCMS records the TPO-coordinated interview schedule.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can schedule interviews for relevant shortlisted candidates.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized.
A candidate has been shortlisted for an opportunity belonging to that Company.
action_or_input: Schedule an interview for the candidate.
expected_result: PCMS permits scheduling for the relevant candidate and opportunity within the Company's authorized scope.

purpose: Verify interview schedules record the required date, time slot, and mode.
preconditions: An authorized actor can schedule an interview.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a schedule with the date missing, with the time slot missing, and with the mode missing; then create schedules using online and offline modes.
expected_result: PCMS validates schedules missing a required detail and accepts schedules with the required details and either supported mode.

purpose: Verify the TPO can track interview progress and status within the TPO's scope.
preconditions: An authorized TPO has interview records within the TPO's placement scope with progress or status recorded.
action_or_input: View interview progress and status as the TPO.
expected_result: PCMS displays the current recorded interview progress and status for relevant records.

purpose: Verify the TPO can track recorded placement outcomes and final status.
preconditions: Supported placement outcomes and final-placement states are recorded.
action_or_input: View placement outcomes and final placement status as the TPO.
expected_result: PCMS displays the supported recorded outcomes and final states.

purpose: Verify the TPO can update supported Student placement records.
preconditions: An authorized TPO can access a supported Student placement record.
action_or_input: Update the Student placement record through the supported placement-record function.
expected_result: PCMS persists the supported update.

purpose: Verify the TPO can update supported Alumni placement records while Alumni access remains read-only.
preconditions: An authorized TPO can access a supported Alumni placement record.
An Alumni user has restricted placement-data access.
action_or_input: Update the Alumni placement record as the TPO, then attempt to modify placement data as the Alumni user.
expected_result: PCMS persists the TPO's supported update and prevents the Alumni user from modifying placement data.

purpose: Verify the TPO can generate a placement success-rate report.
preconditions: An authorized TPO can access placement reporting.
action_or_input: Request a placement success-rate report.
expected_result: PCMS provides the supported placement success-rate report.

purpose: Verify the TPO can generate company participation trend reporting.
preconditions: An authorized TPO can access placement reporting.
action_or_input: Request a company participation trend report.
expected_result: PCMS provides the supported company participation trend report.

purpose: Verify the TPO can generate salary package distribution reporting.
preconditions: An authorized TPO can access placement reporting.
action_or_input: Request a salary package distribution report.
expected_result: PCMS provides the supported salary package distribution report.

purpose: Verify the TPO can generate employment trend reporting.
preconditions: An authorized TPO can access placement reporting.
action_or_input: Request an employment trend report.
expected_result: PCMS provides the supported employment trend report.

purpose: Verify the Placement Chairman can view placement statistics available for oversight.
preconditions: Placement statistics are available in PCMS for oversight.
The Placement Chairman is authenticated.
action_or_input: View placement statistics as the Placement Chairman.
expected_result: PCMS displays the available placement statistics for oversight.

purpose: Verify the Placement Chairman can view summarized placement reports.
preconditions: Summarized placement reports are available in PCMS.
The Placement Chairman is authenticated.
action_or_input: View summarized placement reports.
expected_result: PCMS displays the available summarized reports for oversight.

purpose: Verify the Placement Chairman can monitor company participation and engagement using PCMS information.
preconditions: Company participation or engagement information is recorded in PCMS.
The Placement Chairman is authenticated.
action_or_input: View the available company participation and engagement information.
expected_result: PCMS exposes supported participation and engagement information derived from PCMS records.

purpose: Verify an authorized TPO can publish a placement-related announcement.
preconditions: An authorized TPO is authenticated.
action_or_input: Publish a placement-related announcement.
expected_result: PCMS publishes the announcement.

purpose: Verify the Placement Chairman can publish official placement-related announcements.
preconditions: The Placement Chairman is authenticated.
action_or_input: Publish an official placement-related announcement.
expected_result: PCMS publishes the official announcement.

purpose: Verify announcements can represent the supported placement topics.
preconditions: An authorized TPO or Placement Chairman can publish announcements.
action_or_input: Create announcements covering placement drives, job opportunities, recruitment drives, company visits, training sessions, training and placement workshops, workshops, and internship programs.
expected_result: PCMS can represent each topic listed in the requirement.

purpose: Verify PCMS maintains announcement history for authorized access.
preconditions: An authorized actor has published an announcement.
action_or_input: Open announcement history using an authorized account.
expected_result: The published announcement is available in announcement history.

purpose: Verify a Company/Recruiter can submit registration information subject to institute approval.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter can access the PCMS registration function.
action_or_input: Submit registration information for participation in PCMS.
expected_result: PCMS records the submitted information as subject to institute approval.

purpose: Verify Company/Recruiter placement functions depend on an available status that permits them.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter has no available authorization status permitting placement functions; also prepare a Company/Recruiter with a status that permits them.
action_or_input: Attempt a placement function under each authorization status.
expected_result: PCMS restricts the function without a permitting status and allows it when an available status permits it; the external institutional approval decision is not modeled as a PCMS decision.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can view and review applications for its own opportunities.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized.
Applications exist for one of its opportunities and for an opportunity outside its scope.
action_or_input: View and review the available applications.
expected_result: PCMS permits review of applications tied to the Company's authorized opportunities and limits access to that scope.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can record a shortlist outcome for its opportunity.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized.
A candidate has an Applied application associated with the Company's opportunity.
action_or_input: Record a shortlist outcome for the candidate.
expected_result: PCMS records the application as Shortlisted.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can manage relevant application records and record supported rejection updates.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized.
A relevant application is associated with its opportunity.
action_or_input: Record a supported rejection update for the application.
expected_result: PCMS records the update within the Company's scope without originating the external recruitment decision.

purpose: Verify an authorized Company/Recruiter can extend an offer to a selected candidate for its opportunity.
preconditions: A Company/Recruiter is authorized.
A selected candidate is associated with the Company's opportunity.
action_or_input: Extend a job offer to the candidate through PCMS.
expected_result: PCMS records the job offer as extended for that candidate.

purpose: Verify a new job posting triggers an automated notification event where required by the accepted notification scope.
preconditions: The accepted notification scope requires notification for a new job posting.
action_or_input: Publish a new job posting.
expected_result: PCMS triggers the corresponding automated notification event.

purpose: Verify application submission triggers an automated notification event.
preconditions: A Student can submit an application to an eligible job posting.
action_or_input: Submit an application.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an automated application-submission notification event without assuming an unspecified recipient.

purpose: Verify a shortlisting update triggers an automated notification event.
preconditions: A supported shortlisting update can be recorded.
action_or_input: Record a shortlisting update.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an automated shortlisting notification event.

purpose: Verify a rejection update triggers an automated notification event.
preconditions: A supported rejection update can be recorded.
action_or_input: Record a rejection update.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an automated rejection notification event without assuming an unspecified recipient.

purpose: Verify affected eligible or shortlisted Students are notified of recorded interview details.
preconditions: An interview schedule applies to eligible or shortlisted Students.
action_or_input: Record valid interview details for the applicable Students.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an automated notification of the recorded interview details for each affected Student.

purpose: Verify the Student is notified when a job offer is extended.
preconditions: A job offer can be extended to a Student.
action_or_input: Extend a job offer to the Student.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an automated job-offer notification for that Student.

purpose: Verify Students are notified about a new supported placement announcement.
preconditions: An authorized TPO or Placement Chairman can publish a supported placement announcement.
action_or_input: Publish a supported placement announcement.
expected_result: PCMS triggers an automated notification to Students, including placement-drive announcements where applicable.

purpose: Verify supported automated placement notifications are handed off as system-generated emails.
preconditions: A supported notification event has a resolved recipient.
action_or_input: Trigger the supported notification event.
expected_result: PCMS hands off the notification as a system-generated email; external email delivery infrastructure is outside the PCMS behavior represented by this test.

purpose: Verify Alumni receive only restricted placement-data access for supported mentorship and networking purposes.
preconditions: An Alumni user is authenticated.
Placement data is available for restricted Alumni access.
action_or_input: View placement data through the Alumni access function.
expected_result: PCMS exposes only the restricted placement-data set made available for mentorship and networking.

purpose: Verify Alumni placement-data access is read-only.
preconditions: An Alumni user is authenticated.
Placement data is available through restricted Alumni access.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify placement data through the Alumni access function.
expected_result: PCMS blocks the modification.

purpose: Verify Alumni cannot participate in active placement workflows.
preconditions: An Alumni user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Attempt to apply, shortlist, schedule an interview, issue an offer, and accept an offer as Alumni.
expected_result: PCMS prevents Alumni from participating in the attempted active placement workflows.

purpose: Verify placement-data access and placement actions follow the user's role and defined access scope.
preconditions: Representative users are available for the Student, TPO, Placement Chairman, Company/Recruiter, and Alumni roles.
action_or_input: Attempt representative placement-data views and actions under each role.
expected_result: PCMS permits or restricts each view and action according to that user's role and defined access scope.

purpose: Verify only authorized stakeholders can view sensitive placement data.
preconditions: Sensitive placement data is available.
An authorized stakeholder and an unauthorized user are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to view the sensitive data as each user.
expected_result: PCMS allows the authorized stakeholder to view the data and prevents the unauthorized user from viewing it.

purpose: Verify only authorized stakeholders can modify sensitive placement data.
preconditions: Sensitive placement data is available.
An authorized stakeholder and an unauthorized user are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify the sensitive data as each user.
expected_result: PCMS allows the authorized stakeholder to modify the data and prevents the unauthorized user from modifying it.

purpose: Verify role-based permissions protect placement-data confidentiality within the PCMS scope.
preconditions: Sensitive placement data exists.
Users with representative PCMS roles and access scopes are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to access sensitive placement data under the representative roles and scopes.
expected_result: Role-based permissions prevent sensitive placement data from being exposed beyond the accepted role scopes.
